# Test fixtures

- `input/` — sample inputs for every supported format, generated by `npm run fixtures`
  (`scripts/generate-fixtures.mjs`) with sharp, pdf-lib, fflate and (for `encrypted.pdf`) Python's pypdf.
  Includes deliberately broken files: `corrupt.jpg`, `empty.png`, `not-an-image.png`, `malformed.*`,
  `entities.xml` (entity-expansion attack), `legacy.doc`, `not-word.docx`, `encrypted.pdf`, `scanned.pdf`.
- `input/sample.heic` — a real HEIC image from the heic2any project (MIT licence,
  https://github.com/alexcorvi/heic2any). HEVC encoders are not freely available, so it is not generated.
- `golden/` — reviewed expected outputs. Tests compare against them with `toMatchFileSnapshot`. If an engine
  change alters output intentionally, delete the affected golden file, re-run `npm test`, and review the
  regenerated file before committing.
